version.description: ZooKeeper version and build string reported

approximateDataSize.description: The approximate size in bytes of the data being handled by Zookeeper.

avgLatency.description: The average latency measured by Zookeeper in millisecs.

minLatency.description: The minimum latency measured by Zookeeper in millisecs.

maxLatency.description: The maximum latency measured by Zookeeper in millisecs.

ephemeralsCount.description: The total amount of ephemerals in Zookeeper.

followers.description: The number of servers using this Zookeeper node as a leader.

maxFileDescriptorCount.description: Maximum number of file descriptors allowed for the ZooKeeper process.

aliveConnections.description: Number of active connections in Zookeeper.

openFileDescriptorCount.description: Total amount of file descriptors open in the system reported by zookeeper.

outstandingRequests.description: Total number of requests waiting to be processed by Zookeeper

packetsReceived.description: Total number of packets received in Zookeeper.

packetsSent.description: Total number of packets sent from Zookeeper.

pendingSyncs.description: Number of pending syncs to carry out to ZooKeeper ensemble followers.

serverState.description: Whether the server is currently a leader or a follower in the cluster.

syncedFollowers.description: The number of servers using this Zookeeper node as a leader that are synchronized with this node.

watchCount.description: Total amount of watches in zookeeper.

znodeCount.description: Total number of data registers in Zookeeper.

title: Zookeeper metrics exposed by four-letter mntr command.
name: ZkServerMetrics
